title: chtypes v1 conformance report
description: The CHTYPES_V1_REPORT file each binding's conformance runner writes after executing every case (docs/guides/fetch-v1.md §10, §3.3 of the v1 fetch-layer plan). The fixtures/server/parity lane's parity gate reads one per binding per toolchain leg.

toolchain.description: The exact toolchain identity this report ran under, e.g. "go1.27.x", "python3.13", "node22.21.0", "rust1.85".

cases_sha256.description: sha256 of the exact case table (under tests/fixtures/fetch-v1/) this report was run against; the parity gate refuses a report whose value disagrees with the head's own case table.

detail.description: Empty on pass; the assertion that failed, on fail.
